name: Ho Chi Minh City to Vung Tau
summary: About 100 km by the Long Thanh expressway, and about two hours on the Vietnam Tourism line. Traffic, the ferry’s sailing minutes, and the Vung Tau pier are check on arrival.

modes.note: The provincial catalogue prints about 100 km by the Long Thanh–Ho Chi Minh City expressway, and about 95 km from Bien Hoa. Vietnam Tourism prints just 100 kilometres and just two hours. A minute table for traffic was not on those pages. Traffic is check on arrival.

Vietnam Tourism names Phương Trang (FUTA) and Hoa Mai. FUTA tickets at the Đề Thám office. Hoa Mai luxury tickets are printed at 150,000 VND from 83 Nguyễn Thái Bình. No 2026 operator timetable was opened, so 150,000 VND is the printed fare only.

GreenlinesDP. Sailing minutes are check on arrival. Vietnam Tourism still prints roughly two hours for a hydrofoil, tickets of 120,000–250,000 VND, and a landing at Front Beach from Bến Nhà Rồng. From 1 July 2026 the operator prints weekday adults at 320,000 VND (was 350,000), seniors 63 and over and children 6–11 at 270,000; weekend adults 350,000, seniors and children 300,000. The booking page instead says children under 6 go free and the reduced band is ages 6–12 and over 63. Saigon boarding from 28 August 2025 is Pier 4, opposite Hàm Nghi. The Vung Tau pier is not named. Weather, tide, and a technical hold can cancel a sailing.

seoTitle: Ho Chi Minh City to Vung Tau — road, bus, and ferry
seoDescription: About 100 km and about two hours by road from Ho Chi Minh City to Vung Tau. Ferry minutes, the Vung Tau pier, and traffic are check on arrival.

faqs.q: How long is the ride from Ho Chi Minh City to Vung Tau?
faqs.a: Vietnam Tourism prints about two hours and about 100 kilometres. The provincial catalogue prints about 100 km by the Long Thanh expressway. A traffic minute table was not on those pages. Check on arrival. Ferry sailing minutes are also check on arrival.
